chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The eye is the strap of the rear.
ai.seo_question: What does the saying 'The eye is the strap of the rear' mean in Shia ethics?
ai.summary: In this concise aphorism from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) employs the metaphor of the 'eye as the strap of the rear' to illustrate how the gaze acts as the primary mechanism that leads the private parts toward their desired object. This saying underscores the Shia ethical principle that visual temptation is the precursor to physical action, emphasizing the necessity of *ghadd al-basar* (lowering the gaze) as a preventive measure against sin.
